intro: Financial services and government entities bore the brunt of a concentrated phishing campaign between April 8 and May 4, 2026, with 60 reported incidents. Threat actors Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit were observed exploiting vulnerabilities including CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The activity, comprising 52 high-severity and 8 medium-severity cases, impacted regions globally, with notable concentrations in Latin America, Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.
